result.title: Defence Rebuttal
result.content: The Defence notes the Crown's acknowledgement that the handover case rests solely on Mira's attributed account in E-001 and that Tavi's account in E-002 records not seeing that handover. Both accounts remain disputed under the limited-use instruction. The fictional Crown must prove the blue-token receipt condition beyond a reasonable doubt on the supplied record. One attributed account of a handover, contradicted by another attributed account stating "I did not see a handover," does not meet that burden.
